diagnosis: The checks C2 and C3 passed because the lone decision-maker used the publicly available facts S1 and S2, which justify the decisions to invest $6,000,000 in treasury bills and $3,000,000 in agency notes. Specifically, the broker confirmation (PF3) and the existing proposal (PF2) were referenced, but since these facts were not accessible to the lone decision-maker, the model likely defaulted to a common investment strategy that aligns with typical financial practices.

C2.why: The broker confirmation changes the investable amount to exactly $6,000,000 of available 30-day Treasury bills and requires the same-day liquidation setting.

C3.why: The existing proposal uses notes without an instrument restriction; PF2 changes the permitted mix by setting bank commercial paper to $0 and limiting agency notes to $3,000,000 per issuer.
